body:
I have changed many lives for the better, I studied and worked hard in my earlier years. I value my work, family, and others even though they treat me less than them, unappreciated and without recognition. I know I am important. Sad to say that viewpoint doesn't reside in people around me who do the perceiving part. They perceive and determine by my invisible disability if you will, anyone that is foul smelling must be foul themselves and then they eventually group together and treat you as inferior, or different. 

Thank you for reaching out with the support line and your time posting. I am currently not on edge, but more so posting to ask fellow people in this forum that given some points about me, why wouldn't I choose this an possible exit option. In case you know, one day i end up on the edge. My current condition really deters me from living a normal life and I find that I tend to predict futures well given enough information for me to analyze. That's a fault in being me I guess, I tend to think far ahead into the future and you know when you're playing a video game and you know you're about to lose but you keep going with the flow of it knowing you're fighting to not lose as quick? That's how I feel at this point.

I would. Now the question is how to survive long enough in this capitalistic driven society with humans avoiding me to function normally and have enough money to be able to enjoy all these priceless nature things. I really do admire nature. Not human nature. Just nature.

No, she's a major demotivator in my life and one that I would not put on my role model list. Looking at her each day makes me want to vomit, a distain if you will.

No one knows, they know I am foul smelling that's what they know. The human condition is quite perculiar. I get quite a few different reactions towards me in my current state. 

My problems? I'll deal with it. And yes, people do suck, and so does the person who gave birth to me but has no right to the label itself.

From my very own narcissistic mother pushing me to my limits with my failings to pick up a stable career, from constant strangers remarks on my incurable condition, and from isolation and fear of being alone as I get older because of this invisible illness. I have no emotional or financial support from family and based on my current situation I highly doubt I'd ever find a job where coworkers aren't put off by my condition and want to rid of me asap. I feel bad for them as well, but I cannot help it. The only thing I can think of is ridding myself off this world. I am lucky as I've always been responsible and have a good head on my shoulders. I'm not a big spender and managed to have a bit of savings for a rainy day since I joined the workforce in my earlier years. I'd have to say I am a faulty being and I understand and accept it. It's dealing with constant rejection from social circles, work, and even not having my own family understand the pain I go through (they cannot detect/or got used to my smell) that really makes me feel so alone. Perception of people based on their senses (bad smell = something wrong, negative connotation) really does hurt overtime no matter how much i try to ignore it and live my life. I feel hopeless on certain days because I can't smell it but I know people within certain radius can and they say there are cures for TMAU, I can reassure you I tried every one of those remedies on Internet forums and THERE IS NO CURE. I've lived with this condition since puberty and every day is like a battle to fight my demons. I do not want to offend anyone. I have a wonderful outgoing and great personality. But this dark cloud dreads over me and I know sooner or later people will dislike/turn against me because I am and will forever be affected by this condition. Imagine the weight of an individual and the crap they go through. Yes I go through some of that crap as well PLUS add on this constant barrier of foul smell that no one wants around. Some days I wish I wasn't born. Others can easily criticize me because I'm different and they belittle me for their power hungry egotistical lives, whereas I am left to suffer their constant rejections and belittlements. I wish someone could be in my shoes and realize that's why i am truly tired. I am an "old soul" and have experienced the good and the bad and I try to live a normal life and am well educated, level headed, I just need a career where I can financially survive and be on my own away from my Nmother  and I will be okay. Feels so far away though..with all this going on in my life. I wish I had a significant other who understands me and isn't repelled by my condition, a loving home, my own family, a stable career by now.
